title: Cargo dep direction in curated-thoughts is asymmetric: when `tools/Cargo.toml` contains `tauri_app_lib = { path = ".....
body: Cargo dep direction in curated-thoughts is asymmetric: when `tools/Cargo.toml` contains `tauri_app_lib = { path = "../src-tauri" }`, `src-tauri` cannot `use curated_thoughts_tools::*` (dependency cycle); the symptom is a clean BLOCKED from the implementer with E0432. Any plan saying 'src-tauri calls fn X from tools' needs a dep-direction check before the brief lands (observed in Task 7; resolved by relocating `enqueue_vault_event` to `src-tauri/src/db/queue.rs`, Task 5b).
